title: Dreadmaul Rock
wikitext:
[[Image:Dreadmaul Rock.jpg|thumb|300px|Dreadmaul Rock]]
'''Dreadmaul Rock''' is the base of operations for the [[Firegut]] [[ogre]]s. It is a large structure, with paths leading to the top and a complicated cave system of ogre mounds within.
